The Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 1-2 games... ) visit the San Antonio Spurs (5-2) in Dallas's eighth game of the season. Dallas (4-3, 2-1 on the road, on a one-game losing streak, 4th in the Southwest and 9th in the West) is 2.5 games back in its division, while San Antonio (5-2, 3-2 at home, on a five-game winning streak, 3rd in the Southwest and 6th in the West) is 1.5 games back.

Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (out, foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (out, knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel, inflammation), and Max Christie is day-to-day with a hip injury and a game-time decision. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf, strain).

The Spurs beat Dallas 122-106 in Dallas on October 24, leaving the Mavericks trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series, and Dallas also lost all four meetings in the 2025-26 series.
